units.zh: 海國大通以來，異域僑民，恆自設信局。
units.en: After China opened broadly to the maritime world, foreign residents habitually set up their own letter offices.
units.literal: Since the great opening to maritime nations, sojourners from foreign lands constantly established their own letter offices.

units.zh: 咸豐十一年訂約，駐京公使郵件，初與總理衙門交驛代寄。
units.en: Under the treaties concluded in the eleventh year of Xianfeng, diplomatic mail for foreign ministers in Beijing was at first forwarded through relay exchange with the Zongli Yamen.
units.literal: In the eleventh year of Xianfeng, when treaties were concluded, the mail of ministers resident in the capital at first was sent by relay exchange through the Zongli Yamen.

units.zh: 同治五年，改由總稅務司匯各駐京公使文件，遞天津寄上海。
units.en: In the fifth year of Tongzhi, the Inspector General of Customs took over collecting documents from all resident ministers and sent them via Tianjin to Shanghai.
units.literal: In the fifth year of Tongzhi, it was changed so the Inspector General of Customs collected the documents of all ministers resident in the capital and forwarded them through Tianjin to Shanghai.

units.zh: 光緒五年，增設封河後由天津至牛庄、煙台、鎮江三路郵差。
units.en: In the fifth year of Guangxu, three courier routes were added for the frozen-river season, running from Tianjin to Niuzhuang, Yantai, and Zhenjiang.
units.literal: In the fifth year of Guangxu, three postal-courier routes were added after the rivers froze, from Tianjin to Niuzhuang, Yantai, and Zhenjiang.

units.zh: 迄十一年，郵務愈繁，總稅務司乃於天津、鎮江、上海各稅務司處專員理之。
units.en: By the eleventh year mail traffic had grown heavy enough that the Inspector General placed dedicated staff at the customs houses in Tianjin, Zhenjiang, and Shanghai to handle it.
units.literal: By the eleventh year postal business had grown still busier, and the Inspector General then assigned dedicated staff at the customs offices in Tianjin, Zhenjiang, and Shanghai to manage it.

units.zh: 此總稅務兼理郵遞之權輿也。
units.en: This marked the beginning of the Inspector General's concurrent oversight of postal delivery.
units.literal: This was the beginning of the Inspector General's concurrent management of mail delivery.

units.zh: 初，光緒二年，總稅務司英人赫德建議創辦郵政。
units.en: As early as the second year of Guangxu, the British Inspector General Robert Hart proposed creating a national postal service.
units.literal: Initially, in the second year of Guangxu, the British Inspector General Robert Hart proposed establishing a postal service.

units.zh: 四年，始設送信官局於北京、天津、煙台、牛庄，以赫德主其事，九江、鎮江亦繼設局。
units.en: In the fourth year, official mail bureaus were opened in Beijing, Tianjin, Yantai, and Niuzhuang under Hart's direction, and Jiujiang and Zhenjiang soon followed.
units.literal: In the fourth year official mail-delivery bureaus were first set up in Beijing, Tianjin, Yantai, and Niuzhuang, with Hart in charge of the matter; Jiujiang and Zhenjiang also soon had bureaus established.

units.zh: 是為中國試辦郵政之始。
units.en: This was the start of China's experimental postal service.
units.literal: This was the beginning of China's trial operation of postal service.

units.zh: 十六年，命通商口岸推廣舉辦。
units.en: In the sixteenth year, the court ordered the service extended at the treaty ports.
units.literal: In the sixteenth year, orders were issued to extend the service at treaty ports.

units.zh: 十九年，北洋大臣李鴻章、南洋大臣劉坤一以各國增設各地信局，妨推廣之路，請速籌善策。
units.en: In the nineteenth year, Li Hongzhang and Liu Kunyi reported that foreign powers were opening letter offices everywhere, blocking China's expansion, and asked for prompt planning of an effective response.
units.literal: In the nineteenth year, Li Hongzhang, minister of the Northern Seas, and Liu Kunyi, minister of the Southern Seas, reported that as various countries kept adding letter offices in many localities, they obstructed the path of expansion, and requested swift planning of sound measures.

units.zh: 總署付赫德議。
units.en: The Zongli Yamen referred the matter to Hart for discussion.
units.literal: The yamen referred the matter to Hart for deliberation.

units.zh: 二十一年十二月，署南洋大臣張之洞疏請舉辦郵政。
units.en: In the twelfth month of the twenty-first year, Acting Southern Seas Minister Zhang Zhidong submitted a memorial asking the court to establish a postal service.
units.literal: In the twelfth month of the twenty-first year, Acting Southern Seas Minister Zhang Zhidong memorialized requesting establishment of postal service.

units.zh: 略言：「泰西各國視郵政重同鐵路，特設郵政大臣綜理。
units.en: He wrote in summary: "Western nations treat the postal service as they do railways, appointing dedicated postal ministers to run it.
units.literal: He stated in summary: "Western countries regard postal service as important as railways and specially appoint postal ministers to oversee it.

units.zh: 取資甚微，獲利甚鉅。
units.en: Rates are minimal, yet the returns are enormous.
units.literal: The charges are very slight, yet the profits are very great.

units.zh: 即以英國而論，一歲所收之費，當中銀三四千萬兩。
units.en: Britain alone collects fees in a single year equivalent to thirty or forty million taels of Chinese silver.
units.literal: Taking Britain alone, the fees collected in one year amount to thirty or forty million taels of Chinese silver.

units.zh: 各國通行，莫不視為巨帑。
units.en: Every country that runs it treats it as a major source of revenue.
units.literal: Wherever countries practice it, none fail to regard it as a great source of revenue.

units.zh: 且權操於上，有所統一，利商利民，而即以利國。
units.en: Moreover, authority stays with the state under unified control, helping merchants and the public—and thereby strengthening the nation.
units.literal: Moreover, authority rests with the state and is unified; it benefits merchants and benefits the people, and thereby benefits the nation.

units.zh: 近來英、法、美、德、日本先後在上海設立彼國郵局，其餘各口岸亦於領事署內兼設郵局，侵我大權，攘我大利，實背萬國通例。
units.en: Recently Britain, France, the United States, Germany, and Japan have opened their own post offices in Shanghai one after another, and at other treaty ports they run post offices inside consulates—usurping China's authority, diverting its profits, and violating international norms.
units.literal: Recently Britain, France, the United States, Germany, and Japan have successively established their own postal bureaus in Shanghai, and at other ports as well they have set up postal offices within consulates, encroaching on our sovereign authority, seizing our great profits, and truly violating universal international practice.

units.zh: 光緒十一年間，前浙江寧紹台道薛福成據委員李奎條陳，請中國自行設局，以挽利權，並經稅務司葛顯禮前往香港、日本，向彼國商議，收回上海所設英、日兩國郵局，已有端倪。
units.en: In the eleventh year of Guangxu, Xue Fucheng, formerly intendant of the Ning-Shao-Tai circuit, acting on a proposal by Li Gui, urged China to open its own offices to recover commercial rights; Commissioner Gell had also gone to Hong Kong and Japan to negotiate withdrawal of the British and Japanese post offices in Shanghai, and progress was already visible.
units.literal: During the eleventh year of Guangxu, the former intendant of Ning-Shao-Tai circuit in Zhejiang, Xue Fucheng, on the basis of a submitted plan by commissioner Li Gui, requested that China establish its own bureaus to recover profit rights; Customs Commissioner Thomas Gell also went to Hong Kong and Japan to negotiate with those countries about withdrawing the British and Japanese postal bureaus set up in Shanghai, and there were already signs of progress.

units.zh: 南洋大臣曾國荃曾據咨總理衙門，飭總稅務司赫德議復辦法。
units.en: Southern Seas Minister Zeng Guoquan had already reported to the Zongli Yamen and directed Hart to draft a plan.
units.literal: Southern Seas Minister Zeng Guoquan once reported to the Zongli Yamen and ordered Inspector General Hart to deliberate and reply with methods of implementation.

units.zh: 赫德亦謂此舉為裕國便民大政，陳有要端七事。
units.en: Hart likewise called the project a major state policy to enrich the treasury and serve the public, outlining seven key points.
units.literal: Hart also said this measure was a great policy to enrich the state and benefit the people, and set forth seven main points.

units.zh: 並稱須有奏准飭辦之明文，使各國皆知系中國國家所設，即可商令各國將在中國所設之郵局撤回，並可商入萬國信會之舉。
units.en: He also insisted on an imperially approved order to implement the service, so foreign states would know it was a Chinese national institution—making it possible to negotiate withdrawal of their post offices in China and membership in the Universal Postal Union.
units.literal: He also said there must be an approved memorial and order to implement it in writing, so that all countries would know it was established by the Chinese state; then one could negotiate for the various countries to withdraw the postal bureaus they had set up in China, and one could also negotiate entry into the Universal Postal Union.

units.zh: 查各關試辦郵遞有年，未能推行及遠。
units.en: The customs service had tried mail delivery for years without extending it very far.
units.literal: Upon investigation, the customs trial operation of mail delivery had run for years yet had been unable to extend far.

units.zh: 外國所設信局，並未裁撤。
units.en: Foreign letter offices remained untouched.
units.literal: The letter offices established by foreign countries had not been abolished.

units.zh: 良由稅關所辦郵遞，與國家所設，體制不同，故推廣每多窒礙。
units.en: This was because customs-run mail differed institutionally from a national service, which repeatedly blocked expansion.
units.literal: This was truly because mail delivery run by the customs service differed in institutional form from that established by the state, so expansion often met obstruction.

units.zh: 現復與葛顯禮面加籌議，知其情形熟悉，各關稅務司熟諳辦法者當不乏人。
units.en: I have met again with Gell to plan further; he knows the situation well, and plenty of customs commissioners at the ports understand how to operate the system.
units.literal: Now I have again met with Gell face to face for further planning; knowing he is familiar with conditions, there should be no lack of customs commissioners at the various stations who understand how to run the service.

units.zh: 請飭總理衙門，轉飭赫德，妥議章程開辦。
units.en: I ask that the Zongli Yamen instruct Hart to draft proper regulations and launch the service.
units.literal: I request that the Zongli Yamen be ordered to relay orders to Hart to deliberate sound regulations and open the service.

units.zh: 即推行沿江沿海各省，兼及內地水陸各路。
units.en: Extend it through the coastal and river provinces and across inland routes by land and water.
units.literal: Then extend it through the provinces along the rivers and coast, and also cover inland routes by land and water.

units.zh: 務令各國將所設信局全撤，並與各國聯會，彼此傳遞文函，互相聯絡。
units.en: Require foreign states to close their letter offices entirely, join the international union, and exchange mail with one another.
units.literal: See to it that all countries fully withdraw the letter offices they have set up, and join in union with the various countries so that documents may be exchanged and mutual contact maintained.

units.zh: 如果認真舉行，各國在華所設信局必肯裁撤。
units.en: If the plan is pursued seriously, foreign letter offices in China will surely be withdrawn.
units.literal: If it is earnestly carried out, the letter offices the various countries have set up in China will surely be willing to abolish.

units.zh: 此各國通行之辦法，有利無弊，誠理財之大端，便民之要政也。」
units.en: This is standard practice worldwide—beneficial and without drawback—a major fiscal measure and an essential public service."
units.literal: This is the method practiced by all countries; it has benefit without harm, and is truly a great means of managing finances and an essential policy for benefiting the people."

units.zh: 總理衙門疏言：「光緒二年間，赫德因議滇案，請設送信官局，為郵政發端之始。
units.en: The Zongli Yamen reported: "In the second year of Guangxu, while handling the Yunnan affair, Hart proposed official mail bureaus—the first step toward a postal service.
units.literal: The Zongli Yamen memorialized, stating: "In the second year of Guangxu, Hart, while discussing the Yunnan case, requested establishment of official mail-delivery bureaus, which was the beginning of postal service.

units.zh: 四年，擬開設京城、天津、煙台、牛庄、上海五處，略仿泰西郵政辦法，交赫德管理。
units.en: In the fourth year, offices were planned for Beijing, Tianjin, Yantai, Niuzhuang, and Shanghai, modeled loosely on Western postal practice and placed under Hart.
units.literal: In the fourth year, it was planned to open offices in the capital, Tianjin, Yantai, Niuzhuang, and Shanghai, roughly following Western postal methods, and to place them under Hart's management.

units.zh: 嗣因各國紛紛在上海暨各口設立郵局，慮占華民生計。
units.en: Foreign powers then opened post offices in Shanghai and other ports, raising fears they would crowd out Chinese livelihoods.
units.literal: Subsequently, because various countries one after another set up postal bureaus in Shanghai and at the various ports, there was concern they would occupy Chinese livelihoods.

units.zh: 九年，德國使臣巴蘭德來，請派員赴會。
units.en: In the ninth year, German minister Brandt asked China to send representatives to the conference.
units.literal: In the ninth year, the German minister Brandt came and requested that delegates be sent to the conference.

units.zh: 十一年，曾國荃咨稱州同李圭條陳郵政利益，並據寧海關稅務司葛顯禮申稱，香港英監督有原將上海英局改歸華關自辦之議。
units.en: In the eleventh year, Zeng Guoquan relayed Li Gui's memorial on postal benefits and Gell's report that the British superintendent in Hong Kong had once proposed turning Shanghai's British office over to Chinese customs.
units.literal: In the eleventh year, Zeng Guoquan reported that prefectural subprefect Li Gui had submitted a plan on the benefits of postal service, and according to Ningbo customs commissioner Gell's report, the British superintendent in Hong Kong had originally proposed transferring the British office in Shanghai to Chinese customs self-management.

units.zh: 十六年三月，劄行赫德，以所擬辦法無損民局，即就通商各口推廣辦理。
units.en: In the third month of the sixteenth year, Hart was instructed that the proposed rules would not harm private letter offices and that the service should be extended at treaty ports at once.
units.literal: In the third month of the sixteenth year, a dispatch was sent to Hart stating that the proposed methods would not harm private letter offices, and the service should immediately be extended at the treaty ports.

units.zh: 擬俟辦有規模，再行請旨定設。
units.en: The plan was to wait until the trial had matured, then seek imperial approval for permanent establishment.
units.literal: It was planned to wait until the operation had taken shape, then again request an imperial order for formal establishment.

units.zh: 此各稅關試辦郵遞之始也。
units.en: This was how customs trial mail service began.
units.literal: This was the beginning of the trial operation of mail delivery at the various customs stations.

units.zh: 十八年冬，赫德以數年來創辦艱難，若再不奏請設立郵政局，恐將另生枝節。
units.en: In the winter of the eighteenth year, Hart warned that years of difficult startup meant further delay in petitioning for a postal bureau would invite new complications.
units.literal: In the winter of the eighteenth year, Hart said that because founding it over several years had been difficult, if a memorial were not again submitted to establish a postal bureau, new complications would likely arise.

units.zh: 十九年五月，李鴻章、劉坤一稱江海關道聶緝槼稟稱，上海英、美工部局現議增設各口信局，異日中國再議推廣，必更維艱。
units.en: In the fifth month of the nineteenth year, Li Hongzhang and Liu Kunyi relayed Nie Jigui's report that the British and American municipal councils in Shanghai were now planning to add letter offices at the various ports—making any later Chinese expansion far harder.
units.literal: In the fifth month of the nineteenth year, Li Hongzhang and Liu Kunyi reported that Jiangsu customs intendant Nie Jigui had stated that the British and American postal departments in Shanghai were now planning to add letter offices at the various ports; if China later discussed expansion again, it would surely be still more difficult.

units.zh: 考泰西郵政，自乾隆初年普國始議代民經理，統以大臣，位齊卿貳。
units.en: Western postal systems began when Prussia, in the early Qianlong era, proposed state management on the public's behalf under a minister of vice-ministerial rank.
units.literal: Examining Western postal service, from the early years of the Qianlong reign Prussia first proposed managing it on behalf of the people, placing it under a minister of rank equal to a vice minister.

units.zh: 各國以為上下交通，爭相仿效。
units.en: Other nations saw it as binding government and society together and rushed to copy the model.
units.literal: The various countries regarded it as linking upper and lower levels in communication and vied to imitate one another.

units.zh: 葛顯禮呈送萬國郵政條例，聯約者六十餘國。
units.en: Gell submitted the Universal Postal Convention, signed by more than sixty countries.
units.literal: Gell submitted the Universal Postal regulations; more than sixty countries were party to the treaty.

units.zh: 大端以先購圖記紙，黏貼信面，送局以抵信資，其費每封口信重五錢者，取銀四分，道遠酌加。
units.en: The main practice is to buy stamped paper, affix it to the envelope, and present the letter at the post office; a sealed letter of five mace costs four fen of silver, with surcharges for distance.
units.literal: The main method is first to purchase stamped paper, affix it to the face of the letter, and present it at the bureau to pay the postage; for each sealed letter weighing five mace, four fen of silver is charged, with additions as distance increases.

units.zh: 其取資既微，又有定期。
units.en: Rates are low, and delivery runs on fixed schedules.
units.literal: Its charges are slight, and there are fixed schedules as well.

units.zh: 百貨騰跌，萬里起居，隨時徑達。
units.en: Whether prices swing or family news travels ten thousand li, it can arrive directly and on time.
units.literal: Whether commodity prices rise or fall, or household affairs ten thousand li away, they can reach their destination directly at any time.

units.zh: 如有事時，並可查禁敵國私函。
units.en: In wartime, private enemy correspondence can also be inspected and stopped.
units.literal: In time of trouble, private correspondence of enemy states may also be inspected and prohibited.

units.zh: 誠如張之洞所稱『權有統一，為利商利民即以利國』之要政也。
units.en: It is indeed the essential policy Zhang Zhidong described: unified authority that benefits commerce and the public—and thereby the state.
units.literal: It is truly, as Zhang Zhidong said, the essential policy of "unified authority, benefiting merchants and benefiting the people and thereby benefiting the nation."

units.zh: 溯自十八年以來，美國一國郵局清單一紙，所收銀圓至六十四兆二十萬九千四百九十圓之多。
units.en: Since the eighteenth year, a single U.S. postal revenue statement listed collections of sixty-four million two hundred nine thousand four hundred ninety dollars.
units.literal: Tracing back from the eighteenth year, on a single postal statement sheet for the United States alone, the silver dollars collected reached as many as sixty-four million two hundred nine thousand four hundred ninety dollars.

units.zh: 張之洞所舉英國收數當中銀三四千萬兩，尚系約略之辭。
units.en: Zhang Zhidong's figure of thirty or forty million taels for Britain was itself only an approximation.
units.literal: The British receipts Zhang Zhidong cited as thirty or forty million taels of Chinese silver were still only approximate words.

units.zh: 利侔鐵路，誠為不虛。
units.en: Profits comparable to railways are no exaggeration.
units.literal: The profit rivals that of railways; it is truly not empty talk.

units.zh: 且西國郵政與電局相輔，以火車輪船為遞送。
units.en: Western post offices also work with telegraph bureaus, delivering mail by rail and steamship.
units.literal: Moreover, Western postal service works together with telegraph offices, using trains and steamships for delivery.

units.zh: 近來法國設立公司輪船十艘，通名信船，遇口停泊，信包未到，不能開碇，其鄭重如此。
units.en: France recently launched ten company steamers known as mail ships; at each port they would not sail until the mail bags arrived—such was the priority they gave to mail.
units.literal: Recently France established ten company steamships, commonly called mail ships; when they stopped at a port, if the mail bags had not arrived, they could not weigh anchor—such was the care taken.

units.zh: 中國工商旅居新舊金山、檀香山、新嘉坡、檳榔嶼、古巴、秘魯者，不下數百萬人，往往有一紙家書十年不達者，緣郵會有扣阻無約國文函之例也。
units.en: Millions of Chinese merchants and workers live in San Francisco, Honolulu, Singapore, Penang, Cuba, and Peru, yet family letters sometimes take ten years—because the postal union holds mail from non-member states.
units.literal: Chinese merchants and artisans residing in San Francisco, Honolulu, Singapore, Penang, Cuba, and Peru number no fewer than several million; often a single family letter fails to arrive for ten years, because the postal union has a rule to detain correspondence from countries without treaty relations.

units.zh: 中國郵政若行，即以獲資置備輪船出洋，藉遞信以流通商貨。
units.en: Once China's postal service operates, its revenue can fund overseas steamers and use mail routes to move trade goods.
units.literal: If China's postal service is put into operation, its receipts may be used to equip steamships for overseas routes, and through mail delivery commercial goods may circulate.

units.zh: 其挽回利權，所關尤鉅。
units.en: Recovering commercial rights would matter even more.
units.literal: The recovery of profit rights involved is especially great.

units.zh: 臣等博訪周諮，知為當務之急。
units.en: We have consulted widely and know this must be treated as urgent.
units.literal: Your ministers have broadly inquired and consulted on all sides and know this is an urgent task of the moment.

units.zh: 爰於十九年劄飭赫德詳加討論。
units.en: Accordingly, in the nineteenth year Hart was ordered to study the matter in detail.
units.literal: Thereupon in the nineteenth year a dispatch was sent ordering Hart to discuss it in detail.

units.zh: 上年六月至十二月，復與總稅務司面商屢次，先後據其遞到四項章程，計四十四款。
units.en: From the sixth through the twelfth month of last year we met repeatedly with the Inspector General, who submitted four regulatory drafts totaling forty-four articles.
units.literal: From the sixth month to the twelfth month of last year, we again met with the Inspector General in person many times; he successively submitted four sets of regulations totaling forty-four articles.

units.zh: 臣等詳加披閱，大致釐然，自應及時開辦。
units.en: We have reviewed them carefully; the main points are clear, and the service should open promptly.
units.literal: Your ministers have examined them in detail; the main points are already clear, and the service should be opened in timely fashion.

units.zh: 應請旨敕下臣衙門，轉飭總稅務司赫德專司其事，仍由臣衙門總其成，即照赫德所擬章程，定期開辦。
units.en: We ask that the throne order our yamen to direct Hart to run the service while we retain overall supervision, opening on schedule under Hart's regulations.
units.literal: We should request an imperial order directed to our yamen to relay orders to Inspector General Hart to manage the matter exclusively, while our yamen still oversees the overall result, and to open the service on schedule according to the regulations Hart drafted.

units.zh: 應制單紙，亦由赫德一手經理。
units.en: Official forms and stamped stationery should likewise be handled entirely by Hart.
units.literal: The official forms and stamped paper should also be managed entirely by Hart.

units.zh: 遇有應行酌改增添之處，隨時呈由臣衙門核定，務期有利無弊。
units.en: Any needed revisions should be submitted to our yamen for approval, ensuring benefit without harm.
units.literal: Where revisions or additions should be made, they should be submitted at any time to our yamen for approval, with the aim of benefit without harm.

units.zh: 至赫德呈內稱萬國聯約郵政公會，系在瑞士國，應備照會，寄由出使大臣轉交其國執政大臣，為入會之據。
units.en: Hart's memorial noted that the Universal Postal Union sits in Switzerland; China should prepare a diplomatic note for its envoy to deliver to the Swiss government as credentials for membership.
units.literal: As to Hart's memorial stating that the Universal Postal Union is located in Switzerland, a note should be prepared and sent through the envoy abroad to be delivered to that country's chief minister as proof of entry into the union.

units.zh: 自可援萬國通例，轉告各國，將所設信局一律撤回。
units.en: China could then cite international practice and notify foreign states to withdraw their letter offices entirely.
units.literal: One may then invoke universal international practice, inform the various countries, and have the letter offices they have set up uniformly withdrawn.

units.zh: 以上所議，如蒙俞允，即由臣衙門欽遵分別咨照劄飭辦理。
units.en: If approved, our yamen will carry out the plan through the appropriate notices and orders.
units.literal: If the above deliberations receive imperial approval, our yamen will reverently comply and issue separate notices and orders for implementation.

units.zh: 俟辦有頭緒，即推行內地水陸各路，剋期興辦。
units.en: Once operations begin, inland routes by land and water will be extended on a fixed schedule.
units.literal: When there is a beginning of operation, inland routes by land and water will immediately be extended, with a set date for launching.

units.zh: 並咨行沿江沿海及內地各直省將軍督撫知照，屆期即將簡要辦法，飭地方州縣曉諭商民，咸知利便。
units.en: Provincial authorities along the coast, rivers, and interior will be notified so that, when the service opens, local officials can explain the rules to merchants and the public.
units.literal: Notices will also be sent to the governors-general, governors, and military governors of the provinces along the rivers and coast and in the interior, so that when the date arrives the brief methods may be ordered through local prefectures and counties to inform merchants and the people, all understanding the convenience.

units.zh: 凡有民局，仍舊開設，不奪小民之利。
units.en: Private letter offices may continue operating so the public is not deprived of their livelihood.
units.literal: Where private letter offices exist, they may continue to operate without seizing the small profits of the people.

units.zh: 並准赴官局報明領單，照章幫同遞送，期與各電局相為表裡。
units.en: They may also register at official bureaus, receive forms, and assist delivery under the rules, coordinating with telegraph offices.
units.literal: They are also permitted to report to the official bureau, receive forms, and assist in delivery according to regulations, in the hope of working together with the various telegraph offices as inner and outer complements.

units.zh: 其江海輪船及將來鐵路所通處所，應如何交寄文信，由總稅務司與各局員會商辦理。
units.en: How mail should be handed over on steamers and future railways will be arranged by the Inspector General in consultation with bureau staff.
units.literal: As to how documents should be handed over for delivery at places reached by river and sea steamers and future railways, the Inspector General and the staff of the various bureaus should consult and handle it.

units.zh: 官郵政局歲入暨開支款目，由總稅務司按結申報，臣衙門匯核奏報。」
units.en: The Inspector General will report postal revenue and expenses periodically; our yamen will compile them for imperial memorial."
units.literal: The annual receipts and expenditures of the official postal bureau shall be reported periodically by the Inspector General, and our yamen will compile and verify them for memorial to the throne."

units.zh: 奉旨：如所議行。
units.en: The throne replied: Proceed as proposed.
units.literal: An imperial rescript ordered: Carry it out as deliberated.

units.zh: 此開辦郵政之始末也。
units.en: Such was the story of how the postal service was launched.
units.literal: This is the full account of the beginning and end of establishing postal service.

units.zh: 自是遍通全國，上下交受其利。
units.en: Thereafter it spread nationwide, benefiting government and people alike.
units.literal: From then on it extended throughout the country, and upper and lower levels alike shared in its benefits.

units.zh: 其郵政區域，北部東起朝鮮、渤海，西訖新疆、青海，北起西比利亞、蒙古，南訖江蘇、湖北、四川，而盛京、吉林、黑龍江、直隸、山東、山西、河南、陝西、甘肅括焉。
units.en: The northern postal region ran from Korea and the Bohai eastward to Xinjiang and Qinghai westward, from Siberia and Mongolia northward to Jiangsu, Hubei, and Sichuan southward, covering Shengjing, Jilin, Heilongjiang, Zhili, Shandong, Shanxi, Henan, Shaanxi, and Gansu.
units.literal: Its postal regions: the northern district extends east from Korea and the Bohai Sea, west to Xinjiang and Qinghai, north from Siberia and Mongolia, south to Jiangsu, Hubei, and Sichuan, comprising Shengjing, Jilin, Heilongjiang, Zhili, Shandong, Shanxi, Henan, Shaanxi, and Gansu.

units.zh: 中部東起浙江、福建，西訖西藏、雲南，北起安徽、陝西、河南、甘肅，南訖廣東、廣西、雲南，而江西、湖北、湖南、四川、貴州括焉。
units.en: The central region stretched from Zhejiang and Fujian eastward to Tibet and Yunnan westward, from Anhui, Shaanxi, Henan, and Gansu northward to Guangdong, Guangxi, and Yunnan southward, including Jiangxi, Hubei, Hunan, Sichuan, and Guizhou.
units.literal: The central district extends east from Zhejiang and Fujian, west to Tibet and Yunnan, north from Anhui, Shaanxi, Henan, and Gansu, south to Guangdong, Guangxi, and Yunnan, comprising Jiangxi, Hubei, Hunan, Sichuan, and Guizhou.

units.zh: 東部即長江下游，東起黃海，西訖湖北、江西，北起山東、河南，南訖福建，而江蘇、安徽、浙江括焉。
units.en: The eastern region was the lower Yangzi basin, from the Yellow Sea east to Hubei and Jiangxi west, Shandong and Henan north to Fujian south, covering Jiangsu, Anhui, and Zhejiang.
units.literal: The eastern district is the lower Yangzi; it extends east from the Yellow Sea, west to Hubei and Jiangxi, north from Shandong and Henan, south to Fujian, comprising Jiangsu, Anhui, and Zhejiang.

units.zh: 南部東起台灣，西訖緬甸，北起江西、貴州、湖南、四川，南訖越南，而福建、浙江、廣東、廣西、雲南括焉。
units.en: The southern region ran from Taiwan east to Burma west, from Jiangxi, Guizhou, Hunan, and Sichuan north to Vietnam south, including Fujian, Zhejiang, Guangdong, Guangxi, and Yunnan.
units.literal: The southern district extends east from Taiwan, west to Burma, north from Jiangxi, Guizhou, Hunan, and Sichuan, south to Vietnam, comprising Fujian, Zhejiang, Guangdong, Guangxi, and Yunnan.

units.zh: 其郵局，則總局、副總局、分局、支局、代辦處，總計六千二百又一。
units.en: Postal offices—head offices, sub-head offices, branches, sub-branches, and agencies—numbered 6,201 in all.
units.literal: Its postal offices—general bureaus, sub-general bureaus, branch bureaus, sub-branch bureaus, and agency stations—totaled six thousand two hundred and one.

units.zh: 其郵路里數，則郵差郵路、民船郵路、輪船郵路、火車郵路，總計三十八萬一千里。
units.en: Postal routes totaled 381,000 li, including courier, junk, steamer, and railway lines.
units.literal: Its postal routes in li were courier routes, junk routes, steamer routes, and railway routes, totaling three hundred eighty-one thousand li.

units.zh: 每面積百里，通郵線路七里又四九。
units.en: Every hundred square li of territory had 7.49 li of postal lines.
units.literal: For every hundred li square of area, postal lines extended seven li and four fen nine li.

units.zh: 其郵件，則通常、特種，總計三萬萬六千二百二十一萬六千二百三十九。
units.en: Ordinary and special mail totaled 362,216,239 pieces.
units.literal: Its mail, ordinary and special, totaled three hundred million plus sixty-two million two hundred ten thousand six hundred thirty-nine pieces.

units.zh: 其包裹，則通常、特種，總計件數三百零二萬二千八百七十二，重量一千零六萬零四百三十三啟羅。
units.en: Ordinary and special parcels numbered 3,022,872 pieces, weighing 10,604,033 kilograms.
units.literal: Its parcels, ordinary and special, totaled three million twenty-two thousand eight hundred seventy-two pieces in number and ten million six hundred four thousand thirty-three kilograms in weight.

units.zh: 其匯兌，則旱匯局、火匯局，總計七百五十八，匯入銀數三百九十三萬六千兩，兌出銀數三百九十八萬四千二百兩，總計銀數七百九十二萬零二百兩。
units.en: Remittance offices—land and railway—numbered 758; inward remittances totaled 3,936,000 taels, outward payments 3,984,200 taels, and combined turnover 7,920,200 taels.
units.literal: Its remittance service had land remittance bureaus and railway remittance bureaus totaling seven hundred fifty-eight; silver remitted in amounted to three million nine hundred thirty-six thousand taels, silver paid out three million nine hundred eighty-four thousand two hundred taels, and total silver seven million nine hundred twenty thousand two hundred taels.

units.zh: 歲入經常二百五十二萬八千五百餘兩，臨時六百八十三萬五千八百餘兩。
units.en: Regular annual revenue exceeded 2,528,500 taels, with temporary revenue exceeding 6,835,800 taels.
units.literal: Annual regular income was more than two million five hundred twenty-eight thousand five hundred taels, and temporary income more than six million eight hundred thirty-five thousand eight hundred taels.

units.zh: 歲出經常二百八十二萬七千八百餘兩，臨時六百四十六萬六千五百餘兩。
units.en: Regular annual expenditure exceeded 2,827,800 taels, with temporary expenditure exceeding 6,466,500 taels.
units.literal: Annual regular expenditure was more than two million eight hundred twenty-seven thousand eight hundred taels, and temporary expenditure more than six million four hundred sixty-six thousand five hundred taels.

units.zh: 出入兩抵，實盈六萬九千九百餘兩。
units.en: After offsetting income and expenditure, the net surplus exceeded 69,900 taels.
units.literal: Income and expenditure balanced against each other, with an actual surplus of more than sixty-nine thousand nine hundred taels.

units.zh: 此據宣統三年統計也。
units.en: These figures come from the third year of the Xuantong reign.
units.literal: These figures are based on statistics for the third year of Xuantong.

units.zh: 其各國郵局設於中國各口岸者，英國則上海、天津、漢口、煙台、福州、廈門、廣州、汕頭、寧波九處。
units.en: Foreign post offices at Chinese treaty ports included nine British offices: Shanghai, Tianjin, Hankou, Yantai, Fuzhou, Xiamen, Guangzhou, Shantou, and Ningbo.
units.literal: As for the various countries' postal bureaus set up at China's ports, Britain had nine places: Shanghai, Tianjin, Hankou, Yantai, Fuzhou, Xiamen, Guangzhou, Shantou, and Ningbo.

units.zh: 德國則上海、北京、天津、漢口、煙台、福州、廈門、廣州、汕頭、南京、濟南、青島、宜昌、鎮江十四處。
units.en: Germany maintained fourteen offices: Shanghai, Beijing, Tianjin, Hankou, Yantai, Fuzhou, Xiamen, Guangzhou, Shantou, Nanjing, Jinan, Qingdao, Yichang, and Zhenjiang.
units.literal: Germany had fourteen: Shanghai, Beijing, Tianjin, Hankou, Yantai, Fuzhou, Xiamen, Guangzhou, Shantou, Nanjing, Jinan, Qingdao, Yichang, and Zhenjiang.

units.zh: 法國則上海、北京、天津、漢口、煙台、福州、廈門、廣州、寧波、重慶、瓊州、北海、龍州、蒙自十四處。
units.en: France had fourteen offices: Shanghai, Beijing, Tianjin, Hankou, Yantai, Fuzhou, Xiamen, Guangzhou, Ningbo, Chongqing, Qiongzhou, Beihai, Longzhou, and Mengzi.
units.literal: France had fourteen: Shanghai, Beijing, Tianjin, Hankou, Yantai, Fuzhou, Xiamen, Guangzhou, Ningbo, Chongqing, Qiongzhou, Beihai, Longzhou, and Mengzi.

units.zh: 日本國則上海、北京、天津、漢口、煙台、福州、廈門、廣州、汕頭、重慶、南京、牛庄、唐沽、沙市、蘇州、杭州十六處。
units.en: Japan operated sixteen offices: Shanghai, Beijing, Tianjin, Hankou, Yantai, Fuzhou, Xiamen, Guangzhou, Shantou, Chongqing, Nanjing, Niuzhuang, Tanggu, Shashi, Suzhou, and Hangzhou.
units.literal: Japan had sixteen: Shanghai, Beijing, Tianjin, Hankou, Yantai, Fuzhou, Xiamen, Guangzhou, Shantou, Chongqing, Nanjing, Niuzhuang, Tanggu, Shashi, Suzhou, and Hangzhou.

units.zh: 美國則上海一處。
units.en: The United States maintained a single office in Shanghai.
units.literal: The United States had one place: Shanghai.

units.zh: 俄國則上海、北京、天津、漢口、煙台五處。
units.en: Russia had five offices: Shanghai, Beijing, Tianjin, Hankou, and Yantai.
units.literal: Russia had five: Shanghai, Beijing, Tianjin, Hankou, and Yantai.

units.zh: 此其大略也。
units.en: Such was the general picture.
units.literal: This is the general outline.

findings.problem: The two records date 上年六月至十二月 to AD 1895 even though the governing memorial is Guangxu 21 (AD 1895). The source's 上年 interval is the prior Guangxu year, AD 1894.
findings.action: Revise only these two date contexts from AD 1895 to AD 1894, retaining the Chinese source wording and their Hart ownership. Rebuild the packet and obtain a fresh independent audit after repair.
